scoring_justification: Absolute penetration counts depend on the MD implementation; only the relative trend (monotonic increase) can be reliably verified. T1 recompute from raw trajectories is infeasible because the paper reports only qualitative snapshots, not a recomputable metric.

outputs.description: Penetration counts of Pd atoms below the first Cu layer for temperatures 300 K, 600 K, 900 K, and 1200 K.

output_contract.notes: The scoring is based on the pattern of counts across the four temperatures. No hidden gold on the exact number of penetrating atoms is imposed.

steps.description: Verify that penetration counts strictly increase with temperature (300 K < 600 K < 900 K < 1200 K).
